meta.title: Product Truth & Foundation Audit — Forensic Revalidation Matrix

data_quality_states.REAL: Data from a verified external source or honestly computed from real inputs.
data_quality_states.PROXY: Approximation of real data — plausible but not directly sourced. Must label as estimate.
data_quality_states.DERIVED: Real data transformed by a legitimate, disclosed computation.
data_quality_states.MISSING: Data that should exist but doesn't — no value shown. Must show honest empty state.
data_quality_states.STALE: Data that was once real but has expired its freshness window. Must show timestamp.
data_quality_states.UNAVAILABLE: Data that cannot be obtained — honestly disclosed. Must explain why.
data_quality_states.DEMO: Fictional data clearly labeled as sample/demo content.
data_quality_states.FABRICATED: [8th state] Synthetic data presented as real without disclosure. Added because the original 7-state schema had no category for undisclosed fake data masquerading as real — the core trust violation this audit targets. Semantically distinct from DEMO: DEMO implies the user knows it's fictional; FABRICATED means the user is led to believe it's real. Must be eliminated or reclassified to DEMO with disclosure.

meta.propagation_rule: FABRICATED propagates upward through all transformations. If any input to a DERIVED or PROXY computation is FABRICATED, the output inherits FABRICATED state — regardless of whether the computation itself is legitimate. Rationale: a real method applied to fake inputs produces fake outputs (garbage in, garbage out). The 'highest violation' state always wins. Applied retroactively to all 9 views.

duplication_issues.problem: Same teams array, same ELO sort, same seed data. Widget 10 shows 8 teams with W/D/L; Widget 7 shows 5 teams name+ELO only.
Both show H/D/A stacked horizontal bars. Different data sources (DB vs hashCode) but visually similar. Could show conflicting values for same match.

positive_findings: xG chart (Widget 9) refuses to fabricate — code comment explicitly rejects estimating xG from goals. Honest empty state.
Next Match empty state (Widget 3, lines 321-325) is a perfect UNAVAILABLE state.
ESPN live data pipeline (Widgets 1,2,8,11) is real and correctly attributed with 'ESPN Live' badge.
News priority chain (ESPN → Newsdata.io → DB) is a reasonable cascade.
No dedicated mock/fake data file imports — fabrications are inline, easier to spot and fix.
